{{Quote|We have your on our screen now. Please identify.|Jhoff to Han Solo piloting the shuttle ''Tydirium''|<ref name="RotJ" />}}
'''Jhoff''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the traffic control officer aboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shuttle ''Tydirium'', transmit the clearance code for shield passage.|Jhoff|<ref name="RotJ" />}}
At the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he controlled the traffic around [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during their fight against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Prior to the battle, Jhoff was onboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer's]] bridge when the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] attempted to sneak onto the moon on shuttle [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']]. When Jhoff asked the shuttle to identify itself, he was soon joined by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who asked for the shuttle's desired landing area, and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], after some hesitation due to Vader [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] his son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], on board the shuttle, requested for Jhoff to deactivate the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] and let the shuttle make its desired landing on Endor.<ref name="RotJ" />

During the Battle of Endor, Jhoff was still present on the bridge when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Merrejk]] announced to Piett that the ship was in attack position. Piett, having orders from [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to only keep the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet from escaping, held the ship's current position.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Equipment==
Jhoff wore the black variant of the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhoff was played by [[Adam Bareham]].
